segments.name: Investment Portfolio
products: third-party investment management and advisory services
segments.description: Invests in residential mortgage assets and provides third-party investment management and advisory services to institutions.
segments.evidence: The Investment Portfolio segment consists of the Company's investments and third-party advisory services activities.

segments.name: Residential Origination
products: Non-Agency and Agency mortgage loan products
segments.description: Originates Non-QM, investor business purpose and other mortgage loans through brokers and bankers, selling them to third-party institutional investors.
segments.evidence: The Residential Origination segment consists of the stand-alone mortgage origination business of HomeXpress that originates consumer Non-QM, investor business purpose, and other Non-Agency and Agency mortgage loan products.

revenueModel.text: Institutions pay fees for non-discretionary investment management and advisory services; HomeXpress earns income from selling the mortgage loans it originates.
revenueModel.evidence: HomeXpress primarily generates income from the origination and sale of its mortgage loan products and, to a lesser degree, the interest on its loans held for sale.

changes.text: In 2025, the company split its single reportable segment into two: Investment Portfolio and Residential Origination.
changes.evidence: These activities were previously reflected within our single reportable segment prior to the 2025 segment reevaluation.
